audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer calls the cage 'his E mist-cage' in spikes[2], early, mid, whys[5] and wants.foe[0]. The cage is Dark Procession (W), a destructible wall on 20/18/16/14/12s. Mourning Mist (E) is a 700-range globule on 12/11/10/9/8s that reduces armour, damages, slows and marks you — and marked targets pull his summoned units toward them at bonus move speed.
audit.why: The two abilities demand opposite responses: the wall can be broken and is a positioning trap, while the mist is a dodgeable projectile whose real danger is the armour shred plus the ghoul beeline. The page told the reader to dodge the wrong one, and never mentioned the armour shred at all.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession (W) boxes you in and is destructible — break a segment rather than wait it out. Mourning Mist (E) shreds armour, slows, and speeds his ghouls straight at you.
sources: enemyKit E text, cooldown and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Quinn/Quinn/Quinn/Skill/Quinn/Skill/Quinn — rows 3, 4 and 6 all disagree with the whys printed beside them.
audit.why: 52.41% over 332 games; the packet chart is Quinn rows 0-3, Skill rows 4-5, Yorick row 6. whys[3] says 'I stay favored', whys[4] says the edge 'plateaus into a Skill window', whys[6] says Yorick out-scales hard — all three matched the packet and not the row.
audit.corrected: Row 3 to Quinn, row 4 to Skill, row 6 to Yorick, both layers.

audit.why: Level 2-3, level 6 roam, first item and the late Maiden window are the right four spikes. Eulogy of the Isles at 160s rank 1 is a slow clock, which is why the lane only plateaus at 6 rather than flipping.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer is written in first person throughout ('this is mine', 'it boxes me in').
audit.why: Breaks the second-person voice used elsewhere.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[0..6], early, mid and late in second person, fixing the ability slots at the same time.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; the cooldown block only said 'traps you for ghouls'.
audit.why: Dark Procession 20s at rank 1 and 12s maxed, Mourning Mist 12s, Last Rites 6s — the last one matters because it is an auto reset, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.
Early Oblivion Orb / Executioner's is genuinely correct here — Last Rites heals him on every empowered attack every 6 seconds at max rank, so anti-heal really does decide extended trades.
